{{Otheruses|Sector Command}}
A '''sector commander''' was an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] responsible for commanding a [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Force]]. One such sector commander was [[Callus]], who oversaw the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]].
